description:
Software Developer 
 On behalf of our client, Procom Services is searching for a Software Developer for a contract opportunity in Hillsboro, OR. 

 Software Developer Job Details 

 Software Development Engineer with minimum 5 years of continuous development experience using C#.Net 5.0 with Visual Studio 2012 or higher, capable of implementing functionality around abstract requirements and high level use cases. Good understanding of object oriented programming & developing reusable components is required. Experience with implementing unit test cases for various modules, and integrate sub modules into a larger solution. Be proactive to learn/adapt new technologies when needed.  

 Software Developer Start Date 

 ASAP 

 Software Developer Assignment Length 

 4+ months (possible extension/permanency depending on performance) 

 Software Developer Mandatory Skills 
 Experience developing in C# 5.0 on .Net 4.5 or higher.  

 Knowledge of C++ and Managed C++ (with CLR)  

 Marshalling data in C#, specifically between C# and C++  

 Basic JavaScript and HTML Experience  

 Experience working with a multi-service, multi-module, cross language project  

 Experience in client/server communications, specifically RESTful API interactions though C#  

 Experience developing code using VS 2012 or higher  

 Knowledge of Windows debugging tools  

 Experience writing unit tests, and unit testing Window services p referable  
 Experience with cloud environment such as AWS or Azure  

 Experience working with Intel Projects: Intel Technology Access, Intel SGX, Intel ME DAL  

 Knowledge of the Windows Network Stack, specifically Filter Drivers  

 Knowledge of cloud and n-tier architecture 

 
 
 PLEASE NOTE THAT WE ARE NOT ABLE TO WORK WITH CANDIDATES ON H1B VISAS OR CANDIDATES REPRESENTED BY THIRD PARTIES.
